  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "$id": "rpnh/typed_call/v1",
  "description": "Static compatible-profile author call contracts. Validation grants no runtime call capability.",
  "oneOf": [
    {
      "const": {
        "schema_version": "rpnh/typed_call/v1",
        "site": "Q.segment_compact",
        "callee": "C",
        "context": {
          "caller_case_ref": "ExactRef<review Case>",
          "caller_phase_ref": "ExactRef<review phase>",
          "caller_binding_ref": "ExactRef<DefinitionBinding>",
          "parent_firing_ref": "ExactRef<transition_firing/v1>",
          "business_invocation_ref": "ExactRef<invocation/v1>",
          "generation": "NonNegativeInt",
          "call_occurrence": "(caller_case_ref, static_call_site, local_call_ordinal)",
          "expected_parent_head": "ExactRef<caller state head>"
        },
        "inputs": [
          {
            "port": "loop",
            "type": "ExactRef<agent_loop/v1>",
            "mode": "explicit",
            "source_path": "QB.current_loop_ref",
            "producer": "Q.read_boundary或此前C返回后已更新的Q.case",
            "default": "无默认；必需",
            "omission_allowed": false,
            "validation": "存在、WAITING_FOR_LLM、属于CTX.parent_firing和business_invocation",
            "on_missing": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISSING",
            "on_mismatch": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISMATCH",
            "on_unresolvable_old_binding": "reconciliation_required:BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE"
          },
          {
            "port": "reason",
            "type": "Enum{turn_cap,response_length,context_pressure}",
            "mode": "literal",
            "source_path": "turn_cap",
            "producer": "Q.segment_compact",
            "default": "无默认；必需",
            "omission_allowed": false,
            "validation": "严格等于本调用点原因",
            "on_missing": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISSING",
            "on_mismatch": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISMATCH",
            "on_unresolvable_old_binding": "reconciliation_required:BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE"
          },
          {
            "port": "force",
            "type": "Bool",
            "mode": "literal",
            "source_path": true,
            "producer": "Q.segment_compact",
            "default": "无默认；必需",
            "omission_allowed": false,
            "validation": "force==(reason in {turn_cap,response_length})",
            "on_missing": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISSING",
            "on_mismatch": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISMATCH",
            "on_unresolvable_old_binding": "reconciliation_required:BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE"
          },
          {
            "port": "target",
            "type": "ExactRef<resource_version/v1, llm_input_target/v1>",
            "mode": "project",
            "source_path": "QB.target_ref",
            "producer": "Q.prepare或segment attach内有限材料物化",
            "default": "无默认；必需",
            "omission_allowed": false,
            "validation": "与loop model_condition及operation.llm_input_target_ref相同；C未知只允许非pressure；等于本prepared-context材料中的target_ref，字段名属于review QB，不冒充现有API",
            "on_missing": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISSING",
            "on_mismatch": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISMATCH",
            "on_unresolvable_old_binding": "reconciliation_required:BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE"
          },
          {
            "port": "history_refs",
            "type": "OrderedSeq<ExactRef>",
            "mode": "project",
            "source_path": "QB.history_refs",
            "producer": "context.py::prepare_agent_turn_context_v1 / latest overlay投影",
            "default": "无默认；必需",
            "omission_allowed": false,
            "validation": "顺序完整并绑定QB.current_loop_ref与overlay cut；空序列是合法值但不是缺字段",
            "on_missing": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISSING",
            "on_mismatch": "fault:CALL_INPUT_MISMATCH",
            "on_unresolvable_old_binding": "reconciliation_required:BINDING_UNRESOLVABLE"
          },
